sentences.en: As a rule, I go to school before eight o'clock.
sentences.zh: 一般来说，我在八点之前去学校。

sentences.en: It seemed that Jim had missed the seven o'clock train.
sentences.zh: 看来吉姆错过了七点的火车。

sentences.en: This lady witnessed an accident at three o'clock this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 这位女士今天下午三点目睹了一场事故。
